items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 09 September 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers the area.


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, soon backing west or southwest 2 to 4, then backing south or southwest 4 or 5 late evening or overnight. Then increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, occasionally increasing 7 late morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain or drizzle later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, occasionally increasing 7 early afternoon, veering west or southwest 4 or 5 in the evening, occasionally decreasing 3 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in west and central areas in the afternoon. Becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Rain or drizzle at first.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
